# cardos (SDK)

> Typed, dependency-free TypeScript SDK for the CardOS API (https://cardos.dev). Issue and manage virtual cards. Sandbox-first: cms_sk_test_… keys move no real money.

## Install & use
- `npm install cardos`
- `import { CardOS } from 'cardos'; const cardos = new CardOS({ apiKey });`
- Namespaces: products, balance, cards, deposits, statements, analytics, disputes, kyc, webhooks, sandbox.
- Money ops (cards.issue, deposits.create) are idempotent.
- Webhooks: verifyWebhookSignature(secret, header, rawBody).
- Errors: CardOSError (status, code).

## Links
- Get a key: https://cardos.dev/partner/developers
- Docs: https://cardos.dev/docs · Reference: https://cardos.dev/reference · OpenAPI: https://cardos.dev/openapi-v1.yaml
- MCP server: https://github.com/CMSCardOS/cardos-mcp
